full_details: The morning was soft. You went up from the south aisle in your turn, past the plain tomb, and knelt three places from a Flemish weaver and three pews from the Lord Mayor. Master Morley knelt in the row behind. You said nothing at the rail. At the house the beef was a boiled piece. Mistress Ansell did not measure the loaf, because it was Easter. Master Verbeke said the loaf she would not measure was smaller than Christmas's. In the afternoon Daniel's book stayed shut, and the chronicle stayed under the cat. You copied nothing. At night you did not give a better answer than the one you gave on the fifth.
one_sentence: You went up past Gresham's tomb, took bread and cup, and at dinner the penny loaf stayed off the notch.
title: Ate the Easter beef
